name: TOTP - MFA Enforcement Filter
short_descr: Edge TOTP MFA enforcement filter. Verifies the mfa_session cookie (HS256) on every CDN request and redirects or denies unauthenticated users. Pairs with totp-app which issues the session after a successful OTP challenge.
long_descr: TOTP MFA Enforcement Filter. Deploys the CDN enforcement side of a two-component TOTP MFA system (proxy-wasm). Must be deployed together with the companion HTTP app. Shared params (MFA_SESSION_KEY, MFA_AUDIENCE, MFA_ISSUER, MFA_SESSION_COOKIE, AUTH_PREFIX) must match on both. MFA_AUDIENCE is fail-closed: the filter refuses every session if unset.

params.name: MFA_SESSION_KEY
params.descr: HS256 key used to verify the mfa_session JWT signed by totp-app. Must be set on both totp-app (signs) and totp-filter (verifies) with the same value.

params.name: MFA_AUDIENCE
params.descr: Required and fail-closed. The filter refuses every session unless this is set and equals the token's aud claim. Must match MFA_AUDIENCE on totp-app (e.g. https://app.example.com).

params.name: AUTH_PREFIX
params.descr: Path prefix the filter bypasses so the login flow can complete. Must match totp-app's AUTH_PREFIX and the CDN path rule routing to totp-app. Default: /auth/totp

params.name: MFA_SESSION_COOKIE
params.descr: Cookie name to read the mfa_session token from. Must match totp-app. Default: mfa_session.

params.name: MFA_ISSUER
params.descr: When set, the token's iss claim must match. Only meaningful if totp-app also sets MFA_ISSUER. Leave unset to skip the issuer check.

params.name: MFA_LOGIN_URL
params.descr: Where to redirect unauthenticated users. Should be a URL on the customer origin that validates the password session and redirects to /auth/totp/challenge?t=<ticket>. If unset, denied requests get a 401 instead of a redirect.

name: TOTP - Challenge-Verify App
short_descr: Edge TOTP MFA bolt-on. Hosts the OTP challenge/verify UI and enrolment flow in front of an existing login. Pairs with totp-filter which enforces the mfa_session cookie on CDN resources.

params.name: MFA_SESSION_KEY
params.descr: HS256 key used to sign the mfa_session JWT. Must be set on both totp-app (signs) and totp-filter (verifies) with the same value. Use a random string of 32+ bytes.

params.name: HANDOFF_KEY
params.descr: HS256 key shared between this app and the customer origin. The origin signs a short-lived handoff ticket after a successful password check; this app verifies it on /challenge and /verify.

params.name: ENROLL_API_KEY
params.descr: Bearer token that gates the POST /auth/totp/enroll endpoint. Pass it as Authorization: Bearer <key> from your backend when provisioning TOTP seeds.

params.name: GCORE_API_TOKEN
params.descr: Gcore API token with KV write access. Used by /enroll to write seeds. Obtain from the Gcore portal under API Tokens.

params.name: KV_STORE_NAME
params.descr: Name of the Gcore KV store that holds TOTP seeds. Create the store in the Gcore portal and pass its name here.

params.name: KV_STORE_ID
params.descr: Numeric Gcore KV store ID (from the portal). Used by the /enroll endpoint to write seeds via the Gcore KV REST API.

params.name: MFA_AUDIENCE
params.descr: Audience claim embedded in the mfa_session token (e.g. https://app.example.com). Required when pairing with totp-filter — the filter refuses every session unless its MFA_AUDIENCE matches. Must be identical on both apps.

params.name: MFA_ISSUER
params.descr: Issuer claim embedded in the mfa_session token. Validated by totp-filter only when set on both apps. Defense-in-depth.

params.name: MFA_SESSION_COOKIE
params.descr: Name of the cookie carrying the mfa_session token. Must be identical on both totp-app and totp-filter. Default: mfa_session.

params.name: AUTH_PREFIX
params.descr: Path prefix for all totp-app routes. Must match the CDN path rule that routes traffic to this app and totp-filter's AUTH_PREFIX. Default: /auth/totp

params.name: MFA_SESSION_TTL
params.descr: How long the mfa_session cookie lives, in seconds. Default: 28800 (8 hours).

params.name: KV_KEY_PREFIX
params.descr: Prefix prepended to userId for KV keys. Override only to share one KV store across multiple apps without key collisions. Default: totp:

params.name: ALLOW_SELF_ENROLLMENT
params.descr: Whether an unenrolled user may self-enroll on first login via /auth/totp/activate. Default: true. Set to false for admin-provisioned deployments.

params.name: GCORE_API_URL
params.descr: Gcore API base URL. Default: https://api.gcore.com. Override only in non-standard environments.

params.name: MAX_ATTEMPTS
params.descr: Max failed /verify attempts per user per 5-minute window before locking out. Default: 5. PoP-local — defense-in-depth only.

params.name: TICKET_TTL
params.descr: How long the origin-signed handoff ticket is valid, in seconds. Default: 90. Should be short — the user is mid-login.

params.name: TOTP_ISSUER
params.descr: Issuer name shown in the user's authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.) next to the account. Default: TOTP

params.name: TOTP_DIGITS
params.descr: Number of digits in the OTP code. Default: 6. Most authenticators support 6 only.

params.name: TOTP_PERIOD
params.descr: Time step in seconds. Default: 30. Must match the authenticator's setting.

params.name: TOTP_ALGORITHM
params.descr: HMAC algorithm for TOTP. Default: SHA1. RFC 6238 mandates SHA1; most authenticators only support SHA1.

params.name: TOTP_DRIFT
params.descr: Clock-drift tolerance in ±steps. Default: 1 (accepts current ±one step). Increase only for deployments with known clock skew.

params.name: MFA_PROOF_SIGNING_KEY
params.descr: Profile B only. EC P-256 private key (PKCS#8 PEM) for signing the one-time ES256 proof cookie. Generate with: node scripts/gen-ec-keypair.mjs

params.name: MFA_PROOF_PUBLIC_JWK
params.descr: Profile B only. Public counterpart of MFA_PROOF_SIGNING_KEY as JWK JSON. Served at GET /auth/totp/.well-known/jwks.json for the origin to verify the proof.

params.name: PROOF_TTL
params.descr: Profile B only. How long the one-time ES256 proof cookie is valid, in seconds. Default: 90. Short TTL is intentional — the proof is single-use.

params.name: MFA_PROOF_COOKIE
params.descr: Profile B only. Name of the one-time ES256 proof cookie. Default: mfa_proof.

params.name: TOTP_BRAND_NAME
params.descr: Brand name appended to the page title and used as the logo alt text on the hosted challenge/enrol pages.

params.name: TOTP_BRAND_LOGO_URL
params.descr: Logo image shown above the OTP form on the hosted pages. Recommended max: 48×180 px.

params.name: TOTP_BRAND_FAVICON_URL
params.descr: Favicon injected as <link rel="icon"> on the hosted pages.

params.name: TOTP_BRAND_BUTTON_COLOR
params.descr: Button background and input focus-ring colour on the hosted pages. Default: #0066cc.

params.name: TOTP_BRAND_BUTTON_HOVER_COLOR
params.descr: Explicit button hover background on the hosted pages. If unset, the button dims slightly on hover.
